title: De tre prinsessene i Hvittenland
world: Present-day Norway. The fisherman's small white house stands on the quay of a fjord village below the royal residence, a big modern house behind a tall fence with guards and cameras. His boat is a small white fibreglass fishing boat with an outboard motor and a pair of oars. Far away lies Whiteland, which is on no map: a beach of sand so white it looks fake, between two steep dark mountains, and beyond the trees a low white castle with blue light strips along its roofs. The wishing ring is slim and shiny like a fitness ring; the tiny ring the queen fastens in his hair is engraved. The magic hat, cloak and boots are a tall grey felt hat, a long dark-grey hooded cloak and tall brown boots, and the magic skis are old wooden skis with leather bindings.
palette: A dark October on the fjord at the start: slate-grey water, wet quays, early dusk and yellow harbour lights. Whiteland is dazzling and unreal: brochure-white sand between steep dark mountains, pale turquoise water, a flat white sky and the cold blue glow of light strips, with fresh snow at the wedding. The journey crosses green June country. Accents: ice blue, white and the gold of the rings.

cast.name: Fiskerens sønn
cast.description: Gutten som vokste opp på residensen etter farens løfte. Han har lært fransk, tysk og protokoll, men ikke å svømme, og havner i Hvittenland i en båt som går av seg selv.
cast.look: A stocky, wide-shouldered young man of about nineteen with a frank, square face, a bumpy nose, grey-green eyes that crinkle when he laughs, short, wavy brown hair and short brown stubble along his jaw. He wears a chunky, cream-coloured hoodie, dark-blue jeans and tan work boots, and a black phone sticks out of his back pocket.
cast.portrait: Background: the fishing quay of the fjord village on a grey October evening.

cast.name: Den unge kongen (fiskerens sønn)
cast.description: Oppdratt ved den kongelige residensen etter et uhyggelig løfte, dras han inn i Hvittenlands prøvelser, vinner en dronning—og mister henne igjen når han bruker en ønskering uten å tenke.
cast.look: A stocky, wide-shouldered young man of about twenty-one with a frank, square face, a bumpy nose, grey-green eyes that crinkle when he laughs, short, wavy brown hair and short brown stubble along his jaw, dressed like a king: a long dark-navy cloak trimmed with thick brown fur at the neck, over a cream roll-neck jumper, dark trousers and tan boots, with a thin, shiny gold ring on one finger.
cast.portrait: Background: the audience hall of the residence under white ceiling lamps.

cast.name: Fiskeren
cast.description: Guttens far, som har levert fisk til kongens kjøkken i tjue år, og som lover bort det han ikke vet at kona bærer under beltet.
cast.look: A lean, wiry fisherman of about forty-five with a long, weather-beaten face, deep laughter lines, a sharp nose, kind, crinkly blue eyes and a long, drooping black moustache but no beard. He wears a round, brimless old sealskin cap, a thick grey wool jumper, orange oilskin bib trousers and white rubber boots.
cast.portrait: Background: his small white fishing boat on the grey fjord.

cast.name: Den yngste prinsessen
cast.description: Den tredje av kongsdøtrene som står nedgravd på stranden i Hvittenland. Hun roper ikke på hjelp, men forklarer gutten hvordan søstrene kan bli fri.
cast.look: A calm, thoughtful young woman of about nineteen with a softly rounded chin, a small nose with a slight upturn, sea-grey eyes under soft brows, a quiet, knowing half-smile and long, wavy golden hair that flows down to her waist. She wears a plain, long-sleeved sky-blue wool dress with a narrow belt of silver links and a thin silver circlet with one pearl.
cast.portrait: Background: the dazzling white beach of Whiteland.

cast.name: Dronningen av Hvittenland (den yngste prinsessen)
cast.description: Den klokeste av tre bundne søstre som kjenner trollenes regler, gir ham veien gjennom prøvelsene og setter én betingelse: at han lytter til faren, ikke moren.
cast.look: A calm young queen of about nineteen with a softly rounded chin, a small nose with a slight upturn, sea-grey eyes under soft brows, a quiet, knowing half-smile and long, wavy golden hair that flows down to her waist. She wears a slim silver tiara set with pale-blue stones, a long, simple sky-blue gown and a short white faux-fur jacket fastened with a round silver clasp.
cast.portrait: Background: the white castle with its blue light strips.

cast.name: Den gamle kongen ved residensen
cast.description: Mannen som reddet gutten som barn og ga ham utdanning og trygghet, men som senere utfordrer ham av stolthet—og utløser tapet ved å kreve å se dronningen.
cast.look: A skinny, elderly man with a bald, shiny head, a clean-shaven face, a long pointed chin, sharp grey eyes and a thin-lipped mouth with deep lines around it. He wears a peacock-blue three-piece suit with a silk pocket square, a white shirt with a stiff collar, a navy tie and polished black shoes, and carries himself very straight.
cast.portrait: Background: the royal residence behind its tall fence and cameras.

cast.name: Veiviseren på den hvite stranden
cast.description: En gammel mann i lys, slitt frakk som møter ham i Hvittenland og gir den avgjørende testen: gå forbi de to første prinsessene og hjelp den tredje.
cast.look: A lean, straight-backed old man of about eighty, as bony and long-limbed as a heron, with a long, narrow, sun-browned face, a hooked nose, bright pale-blue eyes under wild white eyebrows and a long white beard braided into one thin plait with a tiny white shell tied at its end. He wears a battered, pale-yellow oilskin coat that flaps in the wind, a pale sou’wester and tall black rubber boots, and leans on a twisted, silver-grey driftwood staff.
cast.portrait: Background: the white beach between two steep mountains.

cast.name: Trollet med ni hoder
cast.description: Det siste og verste av de tre trollene i slottet. Det kommer den tredje natten med ni hoder og ni ris.
cast.look: A troll as tall as a house, with a huge, round, lumpy body of creamy-white hide covered in big chocolate-brown patches like a cow's, stumpy legs and big round hands with thick claws. Nine heads grow in a ring around the top of its body like a crown, each with a wide pink snout, small sleepy brown eyes, floppy ears and a wide, grinning mouth. It wears a huge, faded red-and-white checked flannel shirt like a nightshirt.
cast.portrait: Background: the small windowless room with candles in a niche.

cast.name: Nordavinden
cast.description: En viljesterk, talende stormkraft som griper inn når alt står på spill, og gir den unge kongen en brutal, presis plan for å stanse bryllupet.
cast.look: A tall, lean, long-limbed storm giant, three times as tall as a man, with a long, bony, windburnt face, hollow cheeks, a long thin nose, a wide mouth pursed to blow and bright, shining silver eyes. His wild, tangled slate-grey hair and long, wispy beard stream sideways as if in a gale. He wears a huge, billowing cloak made of dark-grey storm clouds, torn into ragged wisps at the edges, and from the knees down he fades into swirling grey mist.
cast.portrait: Background: a stormy grey sky above the sea.

places.name: the Castle in Whiteland
places.look: A long, low, white modern building in a clearing of dark spruce just above a beach of dazzling white sand, with flat roofs edged by glowing blue light strips, big dark windows and a wide flight of pale stone steps up to glass double doors. In front of it, a white wall with an arched gateway. It looks like a brand-new conference hotel that nobody ever got round to opening.

cover.prompt: At night on a vast, dark sea, the small white fishing boat glides along all by itself with a white wave at the bow and its engine silent. The Fisher Lad sits in it in an orange life jacket, a dead phone in his hand, looking up at the stars in wonder; far ahead, a thin line of dazzling white shore glows on the horizon under the first pale light of dawn.
cover.caption: Båten gikk hele natten.
cover.alt: En liten, hvit fiskebåt glir av seg selv over et mørkt hav om natten. Gutten sitter i båten i redningsvest, og langt fremme lyser en kritthvit strand.

illustrations.anchor: «Får jeg det som konen din bærer under beltet», sa det, «skal du få fisk nok.»
illustrations.prompt: Late on a grey October afternoon, the Fisherman stands in his small white fibreglass fishing boat on the dark fjord, a rod in his hands and an empty fish box at his feet. A couple of metres from the side, a strange, pale head with long strands of kelp for hair has risen out of the water, only the head, and it stares at him with a sly, patient smile. The Fisherman stares back, frozen. Mountains and a few lit houses line the far shore.
illustrations.caption: «Får jeg det som konen din bærer under beltet», sa det, «skal du få fisk nok.»
illustrations.alt: Fiskeren står i den lille båten sin på fjorden en grå oktoberkveld. Et par meter fra ripen har et underlig hode med tang i håret dukket opp av sjøen og ser på ham.

illustrations.anchor: «Barnet tar jeg til meg», sa han.
illustrations.prompt: In the small kitchen of the fisherman's house by the quay, the Old King, in his peacock-blue suit and a camel overcoat, stands by the table with one hand raised in a solemn promise. The Fisherman sits at the table, grey-faced, and beside him his wife, a thin woman with a long, gentle face and brown hair in a low ponytail, clutches a crumpled tissue, her eyes red from crying. Through the window, a guard waits beside a black car on the quay.
illustrations.caption: «Barnet tar jeg til meg», sa han.
illustrations.alt: Den gamle kongen står på kjøkkenet i fiskerhuset og lover å ta barnet til seg. Fiskeren og konen sitter ved bordet, og konen har røde øyne av gråt. Ute ved bilen venter en vakt.

illustrations.anchor: I samme øyeblikk gled båten fra kaien.
illustrations.prompt: Evening at the fishing quay: the small white boat is gliding away from the quay all by itself, its mooring rope trailing loose and its engine silent, with white foam at the bow. Inside, the Fisher Lad in an orange life jacket hauls back on the oars with all his strength, his face straining. On the quay, the Fisherman shouts after him with both arms out. Beyond lie the dark fjord and the lights of the village.
illustrations.caption: I samme øyeblikk gled båten fra kaien.
illustrations.alt: Båten glir ut fra kaien av seg selv med hvitt skum om baugen. Gutten i redningsvest ror imot av alle krefter, og faren roper etter ham fra kaien.

illustrations.anchor: En gammel mann kom gående mot ham langs vannkanten.
illustrations.prompt: Dawn on a beach between two steep, dark mountains, the sand so white it looks fake, like a travel-brochure photo. The Fisher Lad stands at the water's edge, soaked through, his hoodie clinging to him and his hair stiff with salt, an orange life jacket dropped on the sand, while behind him the empty boat drifts calmly back out across the pale water. Along the waterline, the Old Guide comes walking towards him, his coat flapping in the wind, and raises one hand in greeting.
illustrations.caption: En gammel mann kom gående mot ham langs vannkanten.
illustrations.alt: Gutten står drivvåt på en kritthvit strand mellom to bratte fjell, og båten driver ut igjen bak ham. En gammel mann med langt, hvitt skjegg kommer gående langs vannkanten og løfter hånden.

illustrations.prompt: On the white beach, three young women are buried in the sand up to their chins in a row, only their heads showing. The first two, a haughty one with a high chocolate-brown ponytail and a round-faced one with a cloud of carrot-orange curls, call and plead after the Fisher Lad, who has walked straight past them with his eyes fixed ahead and his fists clenched in his hoodie pockets. He stops before the third head, the Youngest Princess, who says nothing and simply looks at him. Beyond the trees gleams the Castle in Whiteland.
illustrations.caption: Den tredje ropte ikke. Hun så på ham til han sto foran henne.
illustrations.alt: Tre prinsesser står nedgravd i den hvite sanden, så bare hodene stikker opp. De to første roper og ber, men gutten går forbi dem med hendene i lommene og stanser foran den tredje.

illustrations.prompt: At the arched gateway of the Castle in Whiteland, two real lions lie on either side of the path like two big sofas, watching the Fisher Lad with heavy-lidded eyes. He walks straight between them, neither stopping nor running, his back stiff and his hands clenched. Beyond the gate, the low white building glows with its blue light strips under a flat white sky.
illustrations.caption: Løvene var ekte.
illustrations.alt: To store løver ligger på hver sin side av porten som to sofaer og følger gutten med øynene. Han går midt mellom dem uten å stanse og uten å løpe.

illustrations.anchor: Han kom til seg selv med et gisp.
illustrations.prompt: In a small, windowless room with a stone floor, lit by a few candles in a niche, the Fisher Lad has just come round with a gasp, pale and shaken but whole, glistening with thick ointment from a clay jar that lies smashed on the floor beside him. Above him looms the Nine-Headed Troll, all nine heads grinning, clutching nine bundles of birch rods in its big fists. The Fisher Lad grips the sword from the wall with both hands, knuckles white, and pushes himself up.
illustrations.caption: Det første han så, var ni hoder med ni glis og ni ris i klørne.
illustrations.alt: I det lille rommet uten vinduer kommer gutten til seg selv, blank av salve fra krukken som har knust. Over ham står trollet med ni hoder og ni ris, og gutten griper sverdet.

illustrations.anchor: Da han kom ut i morgenlyset, sto alle tre prinsessene på stranden, skitne og frie.
illustrations.prompt: In the pale morning light on the white beach, the three princesses stand free at last, sandy and dishevelled, beside three empty holes in the sand. The haughty one with the chocolate-brown ponytail weeps into her hands, the plump one with the carrot-orange curls laughs out loud, and the Youngest Princess walks up to the Fisher Lad and takes his hand. He stands there in his damp hoodie, lost for words.
illustrations.caption: Den yngste gikk bort til ham og tok ham i hånden.
illustrations.alt: De tre prinsessene står frie på den hvite stranden. Den eldste gråter, den mellomste ler, og den yngste går bort til gutten og tar ham i hånden.

illustrations.anchor: Han ønsket seg hjem og sto på kjøkkenet til foreldrene, midt i frokosten, i en mørk kappe med pels i kragen.
illustrations.prompt: In the small kitchen of the fisherman's house at breakfast time, the Young King has suddenly appeared in the middle of the floor in his dark cloak with its fur trim. At the table, the Fisherman has set down his coffee cup and stares, while his wife, a thin woman with a long, gentle face and brown hair in a low ponytail, presses her hand over her mouth. Bread, cheese and a coffee pot stand on the table.
illustrations.caption: De kunne ikke få sett nok på ham.
illustrations.alt: Den unge kongen står plutselig midt på kjøkkengulvet hjemme i en mørk kappe med pels i kragen. Faren har satt fra seg kaffekoppen, og moren holder seg for munnen.

illustrations.anchor: Hun tok fram en liten ring med navnet sitt inngravert og festet den i håret hans, hardt, så han kjente det.
illustrations.prompt: In the audience hall of the residence, under harsh white ceiling lamps, the Queen, pale and grave, fastens a tiny engraved ring into a lock of the Young King's hair, pulling it tight; he stands completely still with his eyes lowered. Behind them, the Old King sits in his chair of state wearing a crown, looking like a man who has won an argument and wishes he had lost it. Four guards in old suits of armour stand stiffly along the walls.
illustrations.caption: Hun festet ringen i håret hans, hardt, så han kjente det.
illustrations.alt: Dronningen fester en liten ring i håret til den unge kongen, og han står helt stille. Bak dem sitter den gamle kongen med krone på og ser på dem. Langs veggene står vakter i gamle rustninger.

illustrations.anchor: Han tok et horn ned fra veggen og blåste
illustrations.prompt: In the yard of a small log cabin at the foot of a mountain in June, an old man with a grey beard and a moss-green anorak blows a long, curved horn, and the animals come out of the forest: an elk, a fox, a lynx and a hare, while a big brown bear sits down in the middle of the yard like a large dog. The Young King, a rucksack on his back and a tiny ring glinting in his hair, watches in amazement.
illustrations.caption: Han tok et horn ned fra veggen og blåste, og de kom ut av skogen.
illustrations.alt: En gammel mann blåser i et horn foran en hytte, og en elg, en rev, en gaupe og en hare kommer ut av skogen. En stor bjørn sitter på tunet som en hund, og den unge kongen ser forundret på.

illustrations.prompt: At the end of a floating dock on a calm June fjord, a lean old man in a sealskin jacket holds a long horn, and the water all around boils with fish. Up through the middle rises a huge, very old pike as long as a rowing boat, olive-green with pale spots and weed trailing from her jaw, looking up at the Young King, who crouches at the edge of the dock and listens intently, a tiny ring glinting in his hair.
illustrations.caption: «Hvittenland?» sa gjedden. «Der er jeg godt kjent.»
illustrations.alt: Ytterst på en flytebrygge står en gammel mann med et horn, og fjorden koker av fisk. En diger, gammel gjedde har kommet opp og snakker med den unge kongen, som sitter på huk og lytter.

illustrations.anchor: Så ønsket han seg av sted.
illustrations.prompt: Out on a wide, wet bog, three ancient, ragged brothers with long, tangled white beards stand knee-deep in the mire, hands still raised from their hundred-year quarrel, and gape. Before them, the Young King, now wearing a tall grey felt hat, a long dark-grey hooded cloak and tall brown boots, is rising into the air and fading away like mist until the bog shows through him.
illustrations.caption: Så ønsket han seg av sted.
illustrations.alt: Tre eldgamle brødre står til knærne i myren og måper. Den unge kongen har tatt på seg hatten, kappen og støvlene og forsvinner opp i luften.

illustrations.prompt: High above a dark, choppy sea, among racing grey clouds, the North Wind strides through the sky with his cloak of storm clouds streaming and bends down to explain his plan. Beside him flies the Young King in the grey hat, cloak and boots, only a faint, see-through shimmer in the shape of a young man, listening calmly. Far below lie a tiny car ferry and a few rocky islands.
illustrations.caption: «Resten tar jeg meg av», sa Nordavinden.
illustrations.alt: Nordavinden, en diger skikkelse i en kappe av stormskyer, farer gjennom luften over et mørkt hav og snakker med den unge kongen, som er nesten usynlig i den grå hatten og kappen.

illustrations.anchor: I det samme tok den unge kongen ham i nakken.
illustrations.prompt: Snow whirls around the Castle in Whiteland, decorated for a wedding with blue light strips along the steps and round the door. The North Wind, towering over the roofs, shakes the building so that the lights flicker and the spruces twist, and carries off a startled prince with slicked-back hair and a white wedding cloak, tumbling high over the treetops. On the steps by the door there is only a pair of boot prints in the snow and the faint shimmer of the invisible Young King.
illustrations.caption: Nordavinden tok ham og bar ham av sted, høyt over trærne.
illustrations.alt: Nordavinden rister slottet, som er pyntet til bryllup, og bærer prinsen av sted høyt over trærne. På trappen ser vi bare sporene etter støvlene i snøen.

illustrations.anchor: Hun ble stående lenge og se på den.
illustrations.prompt: In the bright white hall of the castle, with a few musicians tuning their instruments in the background, the Young King, thin and pale, with a scruffy, grown-out brown beard, bows his head to show the Queen the tiny ring fastened in his hair. The Queen, in her white wedding dress, has stood looking at it for a long time; now her face breaks into pure joy.
illustrations.caption: Hun ble stående lenge og se på den. Så ble hun hjertens glad.
illustrations.alt: Den unge kongen er mager og blek og har fått skjegg. Han bøyer hodet og viser dronningen ringen i håret, og dronningen i brudekjole blir hjertens glad.
